title: The Temple Wakes
project: A haunted, unknown Maya temple in the deep forest: a hybrid-orchestral cue of pressure that does not let go
brief: a high-tension, Hans Zimmer-style hybrid orchestral cue for an unwelcoming adventure through the deep forest into a haunted ancient Maya temple: a pulse that never stops, braams, drums, ritual whistles and a stone door, ending on a cut
audience: a listener on headphones, a living-room 5.1 and a 7.1.4 room, and on a phone speaker; they came for the pressure
purpose: a 117-second cue in which the walker is drawn up, into and through a temple that wakes, and the door shuts behind them
point_of_view: the walker: the steps are the nearest sound; the orchestra and the temple are what is closing in
job: hold pressure from bar 5 to the cut: no section is a rest, except the two beats that are the held breath
turn the story three times with a braam each: the door (bar 21), the awakening (bar 33), the run (bar 45)
let the ritual sounds be the unknown: a whistle that is not a bird, a conch that is not a horn, an echo that is not a voice
story: A walker comes to the foot of a temple the forest has swallowed. A twig breaks; the night insects stop. The steps up are answered by a chirp that runs away down the stairs. A stone door opens by itself. In the passage the pulse never stops; a slab drops behind them; for two beats there is nothing. Then the temple wakes, drums on every side, a whistle that sounds like a scream, and the run begins. The door shuts and the music is cut.

sections.name: the_approach
sections.action: the walker comes to the foot of an overgrown temple at night
sections.music: a D pedal in the basses, a heartbeat in the timpani, a semitone D/Eb in the high strings; the cello pulse starts quietly at bar 5; a far whistle; a twig breaks at bar 8

sections.name: the_stairs
sections.action: the steps up the pyramid, and something that answers them
sections.music: a conch blast, steps on stone one a beat, the chirped echo, the pulse doubles to sixteenths at bar 17, the drums begin far away

sections.name: the_descent
sections.action: a stone door grinds open and the passage goes down
sections.music: braam on the door, drips, the pulse never stops, a cluster in the choir, the slab drops at bar 29, then two beats of nothing at bar 32

sections.name: the_awakening
sections.action: the temple wakes: the walls answer
sections.music: a braam, the full orchestra on a 3+3+2 drum pattern, the horns state the theme, the violins climb a semitone a bar, a whistle from every side

sections.name: the_run
sections.action: the run for the way out, and the door shuts
sections.music: everything at once on every beat, a braam at bar 45, the stone slab slams and the music is cut dead

motifs.name: the semitone
motifs.shape: D against Eb: a minor second held, flickered and stacked
motifs.returns: in the ostinato cells, the high strings, the choir cluster and the horns' theme; the last chord keeps it

motifs.name: the horns' theme
motifs.shape: D, Eb, D, A: a fall to the flat second and a leap to the fifth
motifs.returns: lifted an octave from bar 41; on every beat in the run

pulse: eighths in the celli from bar 5 that become sixteenths at bar 17 and never stop; footsteps on stone are the second pulse; a 3+3+2 drum pattern from bar 33

hits.why: the held breath before the temple wakes

hits.why: the turn: the place is alive

two beats of silence at 78.81 s

delivery.played_on: a headphone listener, a living-room 5.1, a 7.1.4 theatre, a phone speaker (mono), and a game engine that takes objects (adm_bw64) or a sound field (ambix)

references: in words, not a track: a hybrid orchestral thriller cue where a low-string pulse, brass braams and a drum ensemble never let go, with the colour of ritual instruments and a stone place

immersive.why: the story is about what is around the walker: the stone, the ritual sounds and the drums come from every side; a stereo mix can say it, a field can place it

movers.why: it closes from behind on the left on the stairs
movers.path: behind left at 6 m, passing to the left of the listener at 3 m

movers.why: the scream is the nearest sound in the run
movers.path: from the right at 12 m to 3 m by bar 47

a narrow stone passage: a close, bright tail
the vault opens above: a taller, longer tail

the drums on both sides in the awakening
the slam and then the cut

notes: Every field is a target someone can check. feel and avoid_feel are what listen.py tests earshot against; sections is the cue's arc in seconds, and its names are what a trajectory or a room change is anchored to; hits_at is what listen.py looks for in the onset list, and hits is the same moments with a reason and a kind (cut, motion or musical). spatial_staging is the room seen from above: each preset must match its own spot. immersive says whether the field is doing a job, what moves and why, and where the room changes (numbers live in the presets). mix_intent says what must be audible and what must stay free.
